Retrieves package tracking information using one of the supported identifiers. Only one of trackingId, barcode, externalId, or packageId should be provided. If the requesting API key was not used to create the order, limited information will be returned. externalId can only be tracked by the client that created the order. includeDeliveryImage is an optional parameter that will include a URL to access the package's delivery image, if available.
